fibres.minimality: Every Q-algebra polynomial presentation needs at least dim_Q(m/m^2) variables. The full rational-unit triangular quotient followed by c elimination achieves that number.
fibres.scope: Minimum number of polynomial generators for the full affine Q-algebra. Does not assert minimum variables after localization or on c=1 section; does not compute Krull dimension or target Hilbert function.
